# tesla v1.20.0 - Table of Contents

HTTP client library, with support for middleware and multiple adapters.

## GUIDES

- [Tesla](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

- Explanations
  - [Client](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/0-client.md)
  - [Testing](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/1-testing.md)
  - [Middleware](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/2-middleware.md)
  - [Adapter](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/3-adapter.md)
  - [OpenAPI](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/4-openapi.md)

- Cheatsheets
  - [Basic Cheat Sheet](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/general.md)

- How-To's
  - [Migrate from v0 to v1](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/v0-to-v1.md)
  - [Migrate away from v1 Macro](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/v1-macro-migration.md)
  - [Working with OpenAPI parameters](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/openapi-parameters.md)
  - [Test Using Mox](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/test-using-mox.md)

## Modules

- [Tesla](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.md): A HTTP toolkit for building API clients using middlewares.
- [Tesla.Client](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Client.md)
- [Tesla.Env](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Env.md): This module defines a `t:Tesla.Env.t/0` struct that stores all data related to request/response.

- [Tesla.Multipart](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Multipart.md): Multipart functionality.
- [Tesla.Multipart.Part](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Multipart.Part.md)
- [Tesla.Test](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Test.md): Provides utilities for testing Tesla-based HTTP clients.

- Behaviours
  - [Tesla.Adapter](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Adapter.md): The adapter specification.
  - [Tesla.Middleware](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.md): The middleware specification.

- OpenAPI
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.md): Reference entry point for OpenAPI-compatible generated clients.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.CookieParam](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.CookieParam.md): A cookie parameter with explicit serialization settings.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.CookieParams](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.CookieParams.md): A collection of cookie parameter definitions.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.HeaderParam](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.HeaderParam.md): A header parameter with explicit serialization settings.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.HeaderParams](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.HeaderParams.md): A collection of header parameter definitions.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.PathParam](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.PathParam.md): A path parameter definition with explicit serialization settings.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.PathParams](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.PathParams.md): A collection of path parameter definitions for `Tesla.Middleware.PathParams`.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.PathTemplate](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.PathTemplate.md): A precompiled OpenAPI Path Templating path.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryParam](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryParam.md): A query parameter definition with explicit serialization settings.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryParams](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryParams.md): A collection of query parameter definitions for `Tesla.Middleware.Query`.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryString](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryString.md): A whole URL query string with explicit serialization.
  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryStringError](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryStringError.md): Raised when a whole `Tesla.OpenAPI.QueryString` cannot own the request query string.

  - [Tesla.OpenAPI.Response](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.OpenAPI.Response.md): Macro for defining generated-client response wrappers.

- Adapters
  - [Tesla.Adapter.Finch](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Adapter.Finch.md): Adapter for [finch](https://github.com/sneako/finch).
  - [Tesla.Adapter.Gun](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Adapter.Gun.md): Adapter for [gun](https://github.com/ninenines/gun).
  - [Tesla.Adapter.Hackney](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Adapter.Hackney.md): Adapter for [hackney](https://github.com/benoitc/hackney).
  - [Tesla.Adapter.Httpc](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Adapter.Httpc.md): Adapter for [httpc](http://erlang.org/doc/man/httpc.html).
  - [Tesla.Adapter.Ibrowse](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Adapter.Ibrowse.md): Adapter for [ibrowse](https://github.com/cmullaparthi/ibrowse).
  - [Tesla.Adapter.Mint](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Adapter.Mint.md): Adapter for [mint](https://github.com/elixir-mint/mint).

- Middlewares
  - [Tesla.Middleware.BaseUrl](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.BaseUrl.md): Set base URL for all requests.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.BasicAuth](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.BasicAuth.md): Basic authentication middleware.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.BearerAuth](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.BearerAuth.md): Bearer authentication middleware.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.CompressRequest](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.CompressRequest.md): Only compress request.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Compression](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Compression.md): Compress requests and decompress responses.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Compression.Error](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Compression.Error.md): Raised when a response cannot be safely decompressed.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.DecodeFormUrlencoded](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.DecodeFormUrlencoded.md)
  - [Tesla.Middleware.DecodeJson](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.DecodeJson.md): Decodes response body as JSON.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.DecodeMessagePack](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.DecodeMessagePack.md)
  - [Tesla.Middleware.DecodeRels](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.DecodeRels.md): Decode `Link` Hypermedia HTTP header into `opts[:rels]` field in response.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.DecompressResponse](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.DecompressResponse.md): Only decompress response.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.DigestAuth](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.DigestAuth.md): Digest access authentication middleware.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.EncodeFormUrlencoded](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.EncodeFormUrlencoded.md)
  - [Tesla.Middleware.EncodeJson](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.EncodeJson.md): Encodes request body as JSON.

  - [Tesla.Middleware.EncodeMessagePack](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.EncodeMessagePack.md)
  - [Tesla.Middleware.FollowRedirects](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.FollowRedirects.md): Follow HTTP 3xx redirects.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.FormUrlencoded](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.FormUrlencoded.md): Send request body as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Fuse](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Fuse.md): Circuit Breaker middleware using [fuse](https://github.com/jlouis/fuse).
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Headers](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Headers.md): Set default headers for all requests
  - [Tesla.Middleware.JSON](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.JSON.md): Encode requests and decode responses as JSON.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.KeepRequest](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.KeepRequest.md): Store request URL, body, and headers into `:opts`.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Logger](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Logger.md): Log requests using Elixir's Logger.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.MessagePack](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.MessagePack.md): Encode requests and decode responses as MessagePack.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.MethodOverride](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.MethodOverride.md): Middleware that adds `X-HTTP-Method-Override` header with original request
method and sends the request as post.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Opts](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Opts.md): Set default opts for all requests.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.PathParams](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.PathParams.md): Use templated URLs with provided parameters in either Phoenix style (`:id`)
or OpenAPI style (`{id}`).
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Query](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Query.md): Set default query params or serialize OpenAPI-style query values.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Retry](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Retry.md): Retry using exponential backoff and full jitter.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.SSE](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.SSE.md): Decode Server Sent Events.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Telemetry](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Telemetry.md): Emits events using the `:telemetry` library to expose instrumentation.
  - [Tesla.Middleware.Timeout](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Middleware.Timeout.md): Timeout HTTP request after X milliseconds.

- Deprecated
  - [Tesla.Mock](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Mock.md): Mock adapter for better testing.

- Exceptions
  - [Tesla.Error](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Error.md)
  - [Tesla.Mock.Error](https://tesla.hexdocs.pm/Tesla.Mock.Error.md)
